name: milp_animal_farm
steps: Decision variables: x_cow, x_sheep, x_chicken (integer, non-negative).
Profit per unit: cow=400, sheep=120, chicken=3.

Constraints: (1) Manure: 10*x_cow + 5*x_sheep + 3*x_chicken <= 800. (2) Total animals: x_cow + x_sheep + x_chicken <= 100. (3) Max chickens: x_chicken <= 50. (4) Min cows: x_cow >= 10. (5) Min sheep: x_sheep >= 20. (6) Non-negativity + integer.

name: milp_animal_farm_lazy_bounds
steps: Same variables and objective as milp_animal_farm.
Use HiGHS高层API: addVariable(lb, ub, obj, type, name) + addConstr.

name: milp_animal_farm_lp_relax_round
steps: Then round each variable to nearest integer respecting bounds.
Check feasibility of rounded solution; if infeasible, adjust.
